program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready household file for a single interview month by merging collected microdata with the control file and the prior-month file, computing a normalized person weight and a month-over-month change in persons. Also averages hours worked and person weights by region for review.

macro_reference.name: hh_core
macro_reference.purpose: Joins control attributes and prior-month counts onto raw microdata, derives the person-weight rate and the period-over-period change in persons, and writes WORK.O1 plus the by-region summary for interview month `p`.

variable_dictionary.name: HHID
variable_dictionary.label: Household identifier
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: RGN
variable_dictionary.label: Census region code
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: IMTH
variable_dictionary.label: Interview month YYYYMM
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through from the input file when populated; if blank, backfilled from the &p macro variable at call time.

variable_dictionary.name: NPER
variable_dictionary.label: Count of persons in household
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: PWGT
variable_dictionary.label: Person-level weight
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: UHRS
variable_dictionary.label: Usual weekly hours worked
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: LFST
variable_dictionary.label: Labor force status code
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: INCB
variable_dictionary.label: Reported income bracket code
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: PRXF
variable_dictionary.label: Proxy interview flag (Y/N)
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: P_NPER
variable_dictionary.label: Prior-period count of persons
variable_dictionary.derivation: prior-period value joined from the prior-period file D3 for period-over-period comparison.

variable_dictionary.name: NPDIF
variable_dictionary.label: Count of persons change vs prior period

variable_dictionary.name: PWGTR
variable_dictionary.label: Person-level weight per 100 persons in household
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed as round(100*PWGT/NPER, 0.01) when PWGT > 0, else set to missing.

variable_dictionary.name: RGN
variable_dictionary.label: Census region code
variable_dictionary.derivation: grouping variable carried through from the class statement (RGN).

variable_dictionary.name: UHRS
variable_dictionary.label: Usual weekly hours worked (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same RGN (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).

variable_dictionary.name: PWGT
variable_dictionary.label: Person-level weight (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same RGN (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).
